modern: Remember that what pulls the strings is the thing hidden within: this is the power of persuasion, this is life, this, if one may say so, is man. In contemplating yourself never include the vessel which surrounds you and these instruments which are attached around it. For they are like an axe, differing only in this, that they grow on the body. For indeed there is no more use in these parts without the cause which moves and checks them than in the weaver’s shuttle, and the writer’s pen, and the driver’s whip.

explained.summary: What really drives you is the hidden thing inside, your mind and reason. That is what persuades and moves you, that is life, and that, you might say, is the person. When you think about yourself, leave out the body and its limbs. They’re tools like an axe, except that they happen to be attached. Without the mind directing them, they’re as useless as a weaver’s shuttle, a pen or a driver’s whip with no one using them.
